content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Minneapolis

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a secondary degree plus documented project-management experience, or a high school diploma with additional experience hours. Review PMI's specific education and work-hour thresholds now. Granite PM Academy's advisors can clarify whether your background qualifies before you enroll.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp, delivered by active certified practitioners. Attend synchronous instructor-led sessions on your schedule across Minneapolis's workweek. You'll cover the PMBOK® Guide framework, real-world case studies, and exam strategy—all required for PMI application approval.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing bootcamp hours, create your PMI account and submit your PMP application with proof of education and project experience. Pay the PMI exam fee at that time. Granite PM Academy guides you through every form field and documentation requirement.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-prep resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor Q&A—to reinforce bootcamp content. Schedule your exam at a Pearson VUE test center. Test on your terms; many Minneapolis professionals complete the exam within weeks of bootcamp completion.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: PMP® certification renews every three years. Earn professional development units (PDUs) through continuing education, volunteer work, or authorship. Granite PM Academy offers PDU-eligible courses and webinars to keep your credential active and your skills current throughout your career.
